sentences.text: Present petition has been preferred by petitioner/accused person facing t h e criminal trial under Section 498A of IPC upon the FIR lodged by respondent No.2/wife who has entered into the compromise with the husband.
Learned counsel for respondent No.2 has confirmed the factum of compromise between the parties.
Considering the same, parties are directed to file joint application for quashment of FIR and criminal proceedings on the basis of compromise duly supported by affidavit of the parties.

Upon filing such application, the matter will be presented before Registrar Judicial-II for verification of the factum of compromise on 23.04.2024 and will be listed on 25.04.2024 along with report of Registrar Judicial-II.

(VINAY SARAF) JUDGE Shub Vinod Kumar Taneja vs State Of M.P. on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171190918/
